GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.8 (2 May 46) CIE
(SCAPIN - 916)
APO 500
2 May 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Dismissal of ISHIKAWA, Koji, Professor of Kyoto Imperial University.
1. Investigation of the activities of ISHIKAWA, Koji, Professor of Kyoto Imperial University, discloses that he has been an active exponent of militarism and ultra-nationalism.
2. In compliance with paragraph 1b(1), Memorandum AG 350(22 Oct 45)CIE, Subject: "Administration of the Educational System of Japan", the Imperial Japanese Government will immediately dismiss ISHIKAWA, Koji, from the staff of Kyoto Imperial University, and will prohibit his future employment by any Japanese educational institution or agency, either public or private.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
